content:
Tony - Partnerships: FYI — CloudLock partnership confirmed. They want a joint webinar + a short benchmark blog and a marketplace listing in their cloud catalog. Looking to run webinar week of May 12. Who can own end-to-end?
Maria (Growth): I'll take webinar comms + landing page. Need final title + 1‑liner from product by Tue.
Aj Patel: What's the target ICP? SMB dev teams or enterprise platform teams? that'll change messaging and lead routing.
Devon (PM): Target = platform teams at scale (enterprises). Benchmark should show latency/cost improvements on real infra (100k tokens/day workload). CloudLock will share a curated workload.
Jen K: I can draft the benchmark narrative and the blog. Need raw metrics and screenshots by Thu so I can write and iterate. Also want a quote from their engineer.
Sarah M: For inbound routing — plan to push registrants to SFDC queue `Partners_Webinar_CoMarketing` and tag leads with `utm_source=cloudlock` + `partner=cloudlock`. Who can provision the queue?
Tony - Partnerships: @Devon can you provision the SFDC queue and give Sarah write perms? Also we need a segment in HubSpot for nurture flow.
Devon (PM): Yep, I'll create `Partners_Webinar_CoMarketing` and add Sarah + Maria. SFDC idempotency note: use normalized email key. I'll post the queue id here when done.
launch-bot: Calendar invite created: "CloudLock x Redwood: Scaling Inference — Webinar" 2026-05-13 10:00 PT. Invite link: https://calendar.company/evt/abcd1234
Maria (Growth): Good. Landing page copy draft: "How one infra partner cut inference cost by 37% — live demo + benchmark." Thoughts?
Aj Patel: Works for enterprise audience, but let's avoid exact % in title unless benchmark final. Maybe "real-world benchmark" instead.
Jen K: I'll avoid the exact number in the headline, but include the 37% in the hero subcopy once metrics are locked.
Sarah M: For tracking — suggested UTM template: `?utm_source=cloudlock&utm_medium=partner_webinar&utm_campaign=cloudlock_may2026`. Please use consistently across CTAs and email.
Tony - Partnerships: Marketing assets checklist: landing page (Maria), email copy + nurture (Sarah), blog + benchmark (Jen), partner co-branded slide deck (Devon + CloudLock eng), demo script (Devon), marketplace listing brief (me + Jen).
Devon (PM): Demo script stub: 15m live demo (inference pipeline + kv-cache), 10m benchmark walkthrough (graphs), 10m Q&A. Need a reproducible script and a small artifact repo (public) with sample commands. I'll spin up a branch: https://git.internal/redwood/cloudlock-demo
Maria (Growth): Can we get a 1-pager for sales with routing instructions and qualifying questions? e.g., "Are you evaluating inference infra for >50k monthly tokens?" Sales want quick qualify.
Tony - Partnerships: Yes — Jen can draft, Maria finalize.
Jen K: I'll draft sales 1-pager and public blog. Plan deliverables: blog + 1-pager draft by Thu EOD, slides + demo script by Fri noon.
Sarah M: Who will own webinar copy approvals? Need product + legal signoff. Timeline: approve email copy by Mon May 4 to start sends.
Devon (PM): Product signoff is on me. Legal — cc @Tony once draft is up.
Tony - Partnerships: CloudLock wants the marketplace listing to go live within 2 weeks of webinar. Need a short feature summary, screenshots, and one co-branded logo SVG.
Maria (Growth): I'll coordinate assets with design. @Design please prioritize 2 screenshots (dashboard + telem graph) and a co-logo.
Aj Patel: Messaging iteration — recommend A/B test subject lines: A) "Live: Real-world inference benchmark" B) "How X reduced inference cost by 37%". Sarah can run split.
Sarah M: Yep I can run A/B. Use 10% traffic test then roll winner.
Devon (PM): Posted SFDC queue id: `Q-7042-Partners_Webinar_CoMarketing`. Added Sarah + Maria. Make sure HubSpot mapping uses that queue id.
Tony - Partnerships: CloudLock will provide partner quote and an engineer for the panel. They asked for a rehearsal Tue May 11 11am PT. Confirm attendees?
Maria (Growth): I'll be on the rehearsal, plus Devon for demo, Jen for slides. Sarah can join for the host run.
Aj Patel: Can we capture 3 short soundbites for social? One technical, one business, one customer-impact. Keep them <140 chars.
Jen K: I'll draft soundbites alongside the blog.
Sarah M: Also need webinar follow-up sequence: immediate recording send + benchmark PDF, then 3-email nurture over 3 weeks. Prep templates by May 14.
Tony - Partnerships: Great. Action items summary: 
- Maria: landing + social assets + coordinate design (due May 6)
- Jen: blog + 1-pager + soundbites (draft May 7)
- Devon: demo script + SFDC queue (done) + slides (May 8)
- Sarah: email sequences + A/B test (templates May 14)
- Tony: marketplace brief + partner liaison (May 10)
CloudLock: will provide metrics, engineer for panel, and logo by May 5.
launch-bot: Reminder set for May 4 09:00 PT: "Webinar asset sync — final copy review"
Maria (Growth): I'll post a landing draft link when ready.
Jen K: I'll ping CloudLock for the quote and the metric export (CSV).
Tony - Partnerships: Thanks team. Ping me if blocked. :rocket:
